fields.title: Improve Perception
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Search results screen loads in 1.8 s. Optimization is impossible this quarter. Suggest four changes without speeding it up.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: card skeletons instead of a spinner; instant feedback on clicking "Search" — button state changes immediately; rendering order — titles and prices before images; reserving space for images so the list doesn't jump. Additionally: show first results as they are ready rather than all at once. All five take days of work, none change the response time metric.
